decisions.reason: It is very close to our core airport-operations software and systems business, so our existing engineering, installed-base knowledge, and in-house R&D give us strong capacity to learn from early adoption and improve it commercially.

This module builds directly on our established apron and integration capabilities, making it a highly related extension that we can refine efficiently through our existing software and project-delivery knowledge.

Although somewhat more administrative than some airside tools, it still leverages airport operational data and our digital integration strengths, so the product fits our move toward broader software-led lifecycle solutions.

Monitoring apron equipment is tightly connected to our installed-equipment experience and analytics capabilities, which means we are well placed to interpret initial market feedback and improve the offer.

Resource management is close to our established airport-operations offering and supports the industry trend toward automated, data-driven coordination, so it merits continued development and market presence.

A controller safety alert service strongly matches our safety-critical airport domain knowledge and benefits from our R&D and likely research cooperation base, giving us good absorptive capacity to enhance it.
